title: Site Build
alt: A committed figure and a page with its fence pass through the figure hook and the theme override into site/.
text: Boxes: docs/figures/site-build.ts (figure spec), docs/assets/figures/ (two SVGs and a JSON file), docs/index.md (page with a figure fence), Figure hook (mkdocs_hook.py), Theme override (overrides/main.html), site/ (built pages).
docs/index.md → Figure hook (fence) → Theme override (HTML) → site/ (page).
Scenario 1, render: The figure is rendered once and committed with its spec. node tools/figures/build.mjs build writes site-build.svg, site-build.static.svg and site-build.json.

Scenario 2, build: mkdocs build turns each page into a site page. The hook, listed under hooks in mkdocs.yml, finds the fence that names site-build. It replaces the fence with the markup recorded in site-build.json. MkDocs renders the page, and the theme override adds the JSON-LD head. MkDocs writes the page, the figure stylesheet and the player files to site/.
Replace this example with a figure of your own code: its evidence anchors name the files it was drawn from.
